remarks: Welcome to this beautifully designed 1,719 sq. ft. new build by AllSeason Custom Homes Inc., located in the growing community of Goodridge Corners. The unfinished basement provides excellent potential for future development and added living space. A rear attached garage adds everyday convenience. Best of all, buyers have the opportunity to personalize the home by selecting and customizing finishes to reflect their own style and preferences. Don’t miss this opportunity to make this exceptional new home your own! (id:67522)
